bull.point: Revenue expanded rapidly alongside solid historical 3-year profit growth.
bull.evidence: Revenue compounded 47.7% a year over 3 years and profit grew 56.5% over the same period.

bull.point: Operating margins showed steady expansion over multi-year periods.
bull.evidence: OPM expanded from 10.0% in Mar 2019 to 16.0% in Mar 2026.

bull.point: Management envisions long-term growth and high contribution from value-added solutions.
bull.evidence: Management plans to double market growth, targets $1 billion guidance for fiscal 2028, and aims for 30% revenue from NPD-led solutions.

bear.point: Operating cash flow turned heavily negative with substantial free cash flow drain.
bear.evidence: CFO fell to -₹600.0 Cr in Mar 2026 (CFO/PAT -164.84%) and FCF reached -₹1,841.0 Cr.

bear.point: Working capital cycle lengthened significantly over recent years.
bear.evidence: Cash conversion cycle lengthened 70 days in 2 years from 123 to 193 days.

bear.point: Analysts raised concerns regarding guidance track record and execution gaps.
bear.evidence: Calls cite a vast variance between expected versus delivered revenue guidance and elevated working capital days.

watch_next: Turning cash positive by end of financial year.
Capex execution of INR300 crores for OSAT and PCB.
Normalization of net working capital days toward 70 to 85 days.
